hardwareHubs.note: Hangar6 is a shared prototyping lab at 6 Davis Drive in the park.
NC State hosts its additive manufacturing research center and a libraries makerspace with 3D printers and a laser cutter.
A 2017 report notes additive manufacturing firms opening or planning sites in the metro area.

makerspaces.name: Hangar6
makerspaces.note: Prototyping lab run by First Flight Venture Center with machining, woodworking and engineering support.

makerspaces.name: NC State Libraries Makerspace (D. H. Hill Library)
makerspaces.note: Lists 3D printers, 3D scanners, a laser cutter and electronics prototyping equipment.

makerspaces.name: N.C. PSI Makerspace
makerspaces.note: NC State lab with 3D printers, laser cutters, power tools and an electronics station.

makerspaces.name: MakeUNCC (Area 49 Makerspace and CCI Makerspace)
makerspaces.note: UNC Charlotte spaces with 3D printers, laser cutters and circuitry components, open to campus users.

events.name: Asheville Maker Faire
events.note: Run by the nonprofit Asheville Makers, with the 2026 edition billed as the sixth.

programs.name: First Flight Venture Center
programs.note: Incubator that launched the Hangar6 prototyping lab with federal EDA funding.

programs.name: NC State Entrepreneurship Initiative Garage
programs.note: Prototyping studios and woodworking shops on Centennial Campus, per a 2014 NC State news item.

specialties.name: Batteries and electric vehicle supply chain
specialties.note: A trade overview cites Toyota's battery campus in Randolph County and its supply chain.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: The same overview lists advanced aerospace products among state manufacturing strengths.

specialties.name: Medical devices
specialties.note: The same overview lists medical devices as a key manufacturing sector.

specialties.name: Fiber optic cable and glass
specialties.note: The overview cites Prysmian's expansion in Catawba County.

specialties.name: Additive manufacturing
specialties.note: A 2017 report describes 3D printing research and production firms across the state.

support.name: NCMEP (North Carolina Manufacturing Extension Partnership)
support.note: Administered by NC State Industry Expansion Solutions, with help on productivity, new product design and supply chain.
